sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover downshifting limits, parking placement, parking on a hill, angle and parallel parking, parking restrictions, electric and hand signals, hazard and stop signals, turn signal rules and errors, sharing the road with vehicles of all sizes, and driving in rain, hydroplaning, wet brakes, floods, fog and winter conditions; they teach parking, signaling, sharing the road and weather techniques and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the parking rules, signal law and weather techniques are stable content printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the downshifting limits, parking placement, parking on a hill, angle and parallel parking, parking restrictions, electric and hand signals, hazard and stop signals, turn signal rules and errors, sharing the road with vehicles of all sizes, and driving in rain, hydroplaning, wet brakes, floods, fog and winter conditions rules on pages 71–76 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
